title: Cornell student groups hold protest over handling of alleged frat-house gang rape

blocks.text: Windows smashed at Cornell overnight amid sexual assault investigation

Windows at Cornell University's main administrative building were smashed overnight and messages spraypainted on the walls following outcry over the New York university's handling of sexual assault allegations.

items: Student groups at Cornell University in Ithaca, N.Y., are holding a protest today over the school's handling of an alleged gang rape in 2024.

The "Justice for Survivors" protest will push for stronger punishments for the men involved at the Chi Phi fraternity incident in October 2024, as well as changes to how the the Ivy League school deals with sexual assault complaints.
The woman involved recently sued the university, seven former students and the fraternity, her own sorority and others in a civil lawsuit.
Cornell's main administrative building was damaged overnight, including graffiti condemning patriarchy and the school's handling of the case.
